point_size.decision: Use shared 5 CSS-pixel preview / 6px expanded circumradii, with circle, triangle, square and diamond scope markers centered at unchanged source coordinates.

annual_guides.decision: Integer-year divisions retain the parent-provided year coordinates and disclosed digitization/date uncertainty.

series_connections.decision: Slide-digitized approximate observations span different tasks, cohorts and measurement definitions; keep every mark unconnected, with no fitted trend or extrapolation.

wider_ratio.decision: Reuse the native generic responsive plot, equal-height card contract and existing branded no-footnote PNG pipeline.
